nom: MEDIHEAL Blackhead Melting Clear Nose Patch

avis.titre: have never had a blackhead product work this well
avis.texte: the process of the masks and using the scraping tool work incredible well at clearing the pores

Very easy to use if you read the directions. First step/patch is sandwiched between two layers that are removed and discarded. In place of step two I use my ultrasonic skin spatula. The evidence is very visible on the spatula, but I've used the included tool and that works too. Step 3 definitely helps calm the redness down and gets left on for maximum benefit. All in all I find it easy to use and much more effective and less painful than pore strips you peel off after they dry and harden. Probably needs a few treatments to see improvement on bad blackheads as they're basically like a hard cork plugging up your pores and usually require patience to treat or extraction.
Works really well. First step softens sebum, second step is to remove it using the tool, third step soothes and tightens the pores. Does exactly what it says it'll do
This is such a terrible product. Getting step 1 on is a nightmare. Did nothing.

avis.titre: Only works for sebums, not blackheads
avis.texte: I have deep blackheads and this strip did not help with that at all. It did remove some sebums and left my nose feeling nice.

Would not stay put on my nose so I had to hold both during the 10-15 it said to keep them on. The tool they provide is plastic and besides scrapping off excess liquid from the patch itself it didn't really do anything. I didn't notice a difference.

I wasnt sure about this product at first, I normally dont even leave reviews… THIS WORKS. I have TERRIBLE black heads on my nose and after step one, I used the tool and got so much gunk out of my pores. I was honestly in shock. I will definitely buy again.
The tool that it came with was nice but it's nothing special. Not worth the money. I have huge pores and it still only really helped with sebum

This is the best blackhead product ever! I have tried so many and they either damage my barrier or dont get rid of all my blackheads. When i tell you this patch got rid of EVERY blackhead in site it was insane! i have never recommended something more to people! If you follow the directions and use maybe 1-3 a month this will change your life!
It works. Thats all. It instantly unclogged my pores. It doesnt work like a biore strip. It softens the pore so you can push the sebum out. Its great.
I love how it breaks it down into 3 steps! super easy to use and it works!
Works really well. Good for price you get 4 from a pack. Gave to my friend and mom they love it

I never leave reviews on products- ever. So this should say a lot. The other review about this product being sorcery is correct. I have spent YEARS and so much money on pore strips and other products trying to get rid of my blackheads and their appearance and nothing has ever worked. I used this product on myself and my bf ONE TIME and the noticeable difference was insane. I got so much crap out of both of our noses. I couldn't believe it. I will 100% be buying these again. Any negative reviews have to be from peole who dont really have black heads or they applied the masks wrong fr.

I tried this and there was definitely a difference. I will say, you do the majority of the work with the spatula provided. The 1st nose strip mouisterizes the area and then you scrape and extract. Nonetheless, it worked!
I have always struggled with blackheads on my nose and chin. This worked so well for me and nothing else ever really has. Will def buy again!
I followed the directions perfectly and honestly this did absolutely nothing for me. Sad that I wasted money on this.

I was browsing in the store and came across this product. Let me tell you, this stuff ACTUALLY works! My facial regimen is a must. I incorporate nose strips weekly, receive facials and chemical peels; however, nothing comes close to removing all the gunk like this product! I used it on my partner since he struggles with blackheads and he's sold! Total gem!

I have very stubborn nose blackheads and NOTHING has worked before. I have gotten professional facials and they did not come close to this product. I got SO much out of my nose, it was disgustingly satisfying. Those that rated low did it wrong.

Got this for my partner and myself. We both noticed a huge difference after the first step strip. Soooo much gunk came out and visibly had fewer blackheads. Only drawback as other reviews have stated, the 1st step one is a bit slippery when first applied. Outside of that, we are going to be buying this product regularly.

avis.titre: Did not work for me at all
avis.texte: I usually have good luck with pore strips, and wanted to try something new and possibly more effective, but this product missed the mark. First of all, the sheet would NOT stick to my face no matter what I did. There was no adhesive on it or anything, so it just kind of hung on my nose and I couldn't look down or it would fall off. I followed the instructions and left it on for 15 minutes and I saw absolutely not a single difference. Used the little spatula and everything; nothing happened at all. Waste of time and money.

I was pretty skeptical to purchase this, especially since I've spent a lot of $$ on other products. These are my results after applying it for the first time!!! The instructions are easy to follow and results are satisfying (to me at least)

I must not have used this correctly????? I followed the directions to a 'T' but did not see any positive results and was very disappointed especially given all the positive reviews. I don't have issues with blackheads, just enlarged pores, so maybe that is my issue is that this product is more designed for blackheads BUT maybe should not be marketed for tightening pores???? Maybe it's just me.

it actually melts away those sebaceous filaments! ive had the biggest pores on my nose for years and ive never been able to get them to budge, with all the aha bha serums and pore strips. theyre noticably diminished after one use :,) i also take it and put it on my chin and forehead! my only complaint is that i wish the first step mask stayed on my nose better during application. its so wet with serum it slips around, and doesnt sit fully on the curves of the nose.
This is literally the best product I've ever used! I was extremely shocked when I used it the first time its very efficient! I will definitely be buying more in the future!

Like the rest of the reviews I have always struggled with my blackheads and finding something to get rid of them. This product was the only thing to easily remove my blackheads and it was so satisfying seeing all that gunk come out of my nose!! This is amazing!

After years on years of exfoliating, pore strips, and peels, I skeptically used this product to attemp to clear my blackheads. After using step 1, all of the blackheads in my nose rose to the top of my skin, to be easily removed with step 2, the spatula. I don't understand how this works, but I will be purchasing again!!

I bought these originally for myself but I decided to use one on my boyfriend. When I tell you I have NEVER seen his nose so clear of filled pores I was SHOCKED. This really does melt down and make it so easy to extract and get all the junk out of your pores. if you struggle with black heads or just congested skin on your nose this is like magic.

I bought this on a whim and I am glad I did! like another poster, I wish I had taken a before picture because it appears to be highly effective. At first glance after removing step 1, I had to do a double take. After step 2, and step 3 were complete, it looked like it removed all of the junk that was in my pore prior. I was so impressed that I used one next on my fiance's nose. He has very oily skin and so I wanted to see how effective it was. The results on my fiance weren't as impressive as mine. But this absolutely works. TL;DR this product is works.

I was a bit skeptical about whether these would be effective, but they are! I have a lot of enlarged pores and blackheads on my nose and these got rid of them in just 30 minutes. Definitely going to be repurchasing these!

i normally dont leave reviews but i just tried this and it absolutely works. i was skeptical especially sinxe there are no current reviewss. i wish i took a before & after pic. it was easy to use. gentle yet effective

avis.titre: Mediheal blackhead melting clear nose patch
avis.texte: For the first time trying it, it did what it says it does. My nose feels cleaner and fresh, Would recommend .
i bought this on a whim thought itd be a gimmick but WOW brought everything out with ease & doesnt irritate the skin
